verdict.rationale: Deel's own pages say clients can log into the Deel platform to see exactly where their application stands from submission to approval. They also promise live progress updates with case-manager notes, a fully digital US visa journey with application tracking, and real-time status updates. That clearly delivers an in-product case-status view. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of next-steps or action items in the dashboard (only implied via case-manager notes), in-depth product docs or screenshots rather than marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
